Self.Wiki: Group placement point (formerly Mass Placement; the game's CSMsbPointGroupPlacementPoint). A group of enemies, placed from a RandomAppearParam row and tied to platoons. The first fields follow Elden Ring's layout; Nightreign has one extra field before the end.

RandomAppearParamID.Wiki: The RandomAppearParam row the group's enemies are placed from. 0: none (0 in every retail point).

PlatoonEventNames.Wiki: The PlatoonInfo events of the group (up to 4).

PartNames.Wiki: The enemies of the group (up to 8).

LinkedAssetNames.Wiki: Assets tied to the group (up to 8). In Elden Ring they only activate while the group does.

UnkT54.Wiki: Nightreign only. -1 in every retail point.

UnkT58.Wiki: Retail uses 0, 1 and -1. Probably Elden Ring's Estus Flask Recovery ID (the recovery row applied when the whole group is defeated), moved back by the extra field.
